params.name: sortDirection
params.description: The direction the returned data will be sorted by.

params.name: sortedBy
params.description: The property by which the returned data will be sorted.

params.name: type
params.description: If set, the results will only contain scans with the specified dataset types.

params.name: parameterSetId
params.description: If set, the results will only contain scans with the specified parameter set.

params.name: referenceId
params.description: If set, the results will only contain scans with the specified provider info reference id.

params.name: status
params.description: If set, the results will only contain scans with the specified statuses.

params.name: includeOldScans
params.description: If set, the results will contain all dataset scans, otherwise, only the most recent scans will be included.

params.name: hasMonitor
params.description: If set, when `true`, the results will only contain scans currently associated with a monitor, or when `false`, the results will only contain scans not currently associated with a monitor.

params.name: trigger
params.description: If set, the results will only contain scans with the specified trigger.

params.name: entityType
params.description: Indicates whether to retrieve dataset scans for practitioners or facilities. Defaults to `Practitioners`.

params.name: entityId
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered by the specified entity identifier (`providerId` or `facilityId`).

params.name: entityName
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered by the specified entity name (provider name/alias or facility name).

params.name: entityNpi
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered by the specified entity NPI number.

params.name: entityDeactivated
params.description: If set, the items will be filtered by the specified entity deactivated status.

params.name: credentialingStatus
params.description: If set, the results will only contain scans for providers in the specified credentialing status.

params.name: providerId
params.description: If set, the results will only contain scans for this provider.

params.name: providerName
params.description: If set, the results will only contain scans for providers with the specified name or alias name.

params.name: providerNpi
params.description: If set, the results will only contain scans for providers with the specified npi number.

params.name: providerDeactivated
params.description: If set, the results will only contain scans for providers in the specified deactivated status.

params.name: sort
params.description: If set, the properties and directions the returned data will be sorted by.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset for the page to start.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The cursor to render the page requested. To load the first page send an empty cursor, then the system will generate the cursors to go to the next and/or previous pages automatically.

params.name: count
params.description: The number of items to include in a single page.

info.name: Get dataset scan parameters for a provider

params.name: datasetType
params.description: The specific dataset type to get the scan parameters for.

params.name: providerId
params.description: The identifier of the provider for which the parameters should be returned.

params.name: parameterSetId
params.description: If set, the results will only return the parameters based on the specified parameter set else the parameters will be returned based on preferred dataset parameter.

params.name: referenceId
params.description: If set, the results will only use the associated provider info to derive the parameters.

items.docs: Returns the list of dataset scan parameters that will be used during a dataset scan.

params.name: matchId
params.description: Identifier of the dataset match to patch.

items.docs: Allows you to reject, accept or restore a previous rejected dataset match. Only a match from the most recent scan can be patched.

params.name: scanId
params.description: The identifier of the scan to trigger refresh for.

items.docs: Triggers a refresh for an existing running continuous dataset scan. Currently only NPDB dataset supports it. For NPDB it will trigger Status request to fetch the latest available response from the site.
